production_dependency: NONE; no repository/engine module read or imported
decimal_policy: 64 significant decimal digits; no float; ROUND_HALF_UP0.01 each regular/overrun component; sum rounded monthly components and covered monthly totals
source_limits: Invoice-observed measurements and contract fields are not independent metering or contract evidence. Historical policy screening requires explicit bounded-normal-regime assumption; this does not verify actual billing, taxes or contractual compliance.
bounded_normal_policy: explicit model assumption, not actual CUSD/legal-status verification

monetary_gate.precise_meaning: Published ANEEL application TUSD demand reference before consumer ICMS, PIS/Pasep, Cofins or CIP additions; no tax gross-up is calculated.
not_claimed: All embedded costs in a regulated tariff are free of taxes.
Observed invoice unit prices or gross charges are comparable to this reference.
Tax obligations or tax rates for this consumer are verified.
monetary_gate.temporal_limit: Tax-semantics explanatory HTML sources are current October 2026 public pages, not claimed archived 2018/2019 enactments. Historical rate values and effective ranges are original official ANEEL rows. Consumer tax law interpretation remains excluded.
monetary_gate.source_binding_assumption: Invoice supplier CNPJ07047251000170, A4 Verde ordinary captive-consumer published reference matched. This is a bounded sensitivity model assumption, not independent CUSD/free-market/special-discount/legal applicability verification.
monetary_gate.oracle_vs_app_coverage: Human oracle includes independently image-verified March; automatic app extraction coverage may exclude it. May monetary always excluded.
